subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar e reproduzir, em textos de resenha crítica de brinquedos ou livros de literatura infantil, a formatação própria desses textos (apresentação e avaliação do produto).

components.description_pt: Identificar as convenções de formatação de críticas de brinquedos ou literatura infantil
components.description_en: Identify the formatting conventions of critical reviews of toys or children's literature
components.cc_component_description: Incorporate formatting such as headings to aid comprehension of informational writing

components.description_pt: Distinguir a seção de apresentação da seção de avaliação em um texto de crítica
components.description_en: Distinguish the presentation section from the evaluation section in a critical review text
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish the main claim from the supporting reasons in argumentative writing

components.description_pt: Reproduzir as convenções de formatação de uma crítica ao produzir próprio texto
components.description_en: Reproduce the formatting conventions of a critical review when producing one's own text
components.cc_component_description: Incorporate formatting such as headings to structure an informational text

cc_matches.description: Introduce claim(s) and organize the reasons and evidence clearly.

Introduce a topic clearly, previewing what is to follow; organize ideas, concepts, and information into broader categories as appropriate to achieving purpose; include formatting (e.g., headings), graphics (e.g., charts, tables), and multimedia when useful to aiding comprehension.

Introduce a topic; organize ideas, concepts, and information, using strategies such as definition, classification, comparison/contrast, and cause/effect; include formatting (e.g., headings), graphics (e.g., charts, tables), and multimedia when useful to aiding comprehension.
